name: collateral-valuation
title_zh: 抵押物估值批量入账，逐笔告诉你价值动没动
tagline_zh: 客户经理说「抵押物估一下」「评估报告出来了」的时候，别再一笔笔翻产品包找抵押池。整批估值挂在一个决策令牌下暂存。
tagline_en: When a banker says "value the collateral" or "the appraisal came in," stop hunting the pool deal by deal. Stage a.
desc_en: Guided workflow. File new valuations against the collateral pledged to a deal. Reads the collateral pool for the product package, stages a batch of dated valuations under one decision token, presents the org's plan and warnings verbatim, and reports per collateral what was filed and whether the collateral value moved. why_zh: 先暂存再落账，一个决策令牌管一批；机构自己的计划和警告不加工、不改写，直接摆给你看。
why_en: Stages before it files: one decision token governs the batch, and the org's own plan and warnings are shown verbatim, never.
limit_zh: 只处理已挂到某笔交易产品包下的抵押池，池子没建、抵押物没挂进去它无从下手；估值日期要你自己给，它不替你挑时点。
limit_en: Only works on a collateral pool already pledged to a deal's product package; no pool, no run. You supply the valuation dates. It reports whether.
title_en: Batch-file dated collateral valuations, report what moved
